hypothesis: The literature contains QUBO/Ising formulations for discrete packing variants and hybrid QA pipelines whose scaffold-sampling ideas transfer to the soft stage of hardening; the review will identify the closest prior art and the formulation gap for continuous congruent-shape packing.
question: What QUBO/Ising formulations exist for packing, and what is the gap to QA-assisted scaffold sampling?
scope: quantum annealing for bin packing / 3D bin packing / set packing (QUBO formulations)
hybrid quantum-classical packing pipelines (D-Wave hybrid CQM/BQM)
quantum-inspired classical optimizers (SimCIM, SQA) applied to packing or layout
discretization schemes for continuous geometric packing into binary variables
warm-starting continuous optimizers from discrete samples
title: Literature review: QA packing and QUBO formulations
